description: Dependency updates: Go modules, GitHub Actions pinned by digest, the Go toolchain, the tool pins in scripts/, and the test images in compose.yaml. Minor and patch updates arrive in one batch on Monday. A breaking update (a major, a minor below 1.0, or a Go toolchain update) arrives as a draft. A human merges every PR. make capabilities runs on every PR that moves go.mod.

packageRules.description: One PR per week for all minor and patch bumps across ecosystems.
mutago changes the mutant IDs between versions, so a bump needs a mutation-gate run and a re-baseline in the same PR. Keep it out of the weekly group, in its own PR.
prBodyNotes: mutago changes the mutant IDs between versions. Before the merge, run the mutation gate on this branch and re-baseline the equivalent mutants (DEVELOPMENT.md, Mutation gate).

packageRules.description: A capslock bump can change the capability baseline, so it gets its own PR where the baseline is regenerated.
prBodyNotes: A new capslock can report different capabilities. Before the merge, run `IQ_CAPS_FORCE=1 make capabilities`. If it fails, regenerate the baseline with `IQ_CAPS_UPDATE_BASELINE=1` and justify new rows in capslock-baseline.notes.md.

packageRules.description: Majors stay one PR each so the review reads one changelog. A major is a breaking update, so it arrives as a draft.
Go toolchain bumps churn every tool and the capslock baseline, so they stay separate and arrive as a draft.
prBodyNotes: A new Go release can break golangci-lint and capslock. Before the merge, make sure that both support this release. A capslock bump can need a regenerated capslock-baseline.json. Run `IQ_CAPS_FORCE=1 make capabilities`.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions are pinned by commit digest with the version in a trailing comment.
A minor update of a version below 1.0 can break the API, so it is a breaking update. It gets its own draft PR and leaves the weekly group and the capslock group. A patch update stays in its group.

The test images in compose.yaml go in their own group, so one bad image does not block the library updates of the week. Each image is pinned to a tag and a digest. A major image update keeps its own draft PR.
prBodyNotes: This PR moves the images of the test stack. The full test suite must pass before the merge. CI runs it, because compose.yaml counts as code.

packageRules.description: Renovate cannot read the Couchbase tag community-7.6.2 as a version. This rule teaches it the form.

customManagers.description: Tool pins. Each pin has a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above and a NAME_VERSION=value line.
